pairs.why: Both put the hanging feeder in front of a soft park backdrop. A's rope-and-branch hang is quieter, while B adds a metal hanger and rivets that the real card's plain rope doesn't have.
Both show the locker against a purple wall, baseboard and wood floor with the same load, so staging gives no reason to choose.
A's pi pattern is large, sparse and tone-on-tone on yellow like the real card, while B's is darker and denser and competes more with the hero.
A's sea is calmer with simpler waves, closer to the real card's modest water, while B's choppy whitecaps and foam are busier.
A's plain plank wall and floor are quiet like the real card, while B adds rivet-studded posts and a busier corner.
Both use similar saturated orange stripes that are stronger at the edges than the real card's soft light bands, so staging doesn't separate them.
Both have a similar load of trees, bushes, path, sky and flowers, and both are tidier and more open than the real grassy close-up.
A's pi pattern is lighter and quieter and sits closer to the real card, while B's is darker, denser and higher contrast.
